video_title: We get HEATED if Jalen Brunson can EVER even catch Allen Iverson 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Jalen Brunson's playoff performance to Allen Iverson's legacy
quotes.excerpt: For our culture, Allen Iverson is that guy. I don't care what them stats say.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Jalen Brunson's career playoff stats with the Knicks are arguably better than Allen Iverson's prime with the Sixers. For our culture, Allen Iverson is that guy. I don't care what them stats say.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: What do they say? Is it the finals?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: No, this is playoffs. These numbers are the same.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: No, they are not the same. We are going to do accolades. The numbers are the same.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's role in the Knicks' championship success
quotes.excerpt: The team of the Knicks is what won the championship. Jalen Brunson is a huge corporate in that.
quotes.quote: The team of the Knicks is what won the championship. Jalen Brunson is a huge corporate in that, but the team of the Knicks is what won it. He had to take those pay cuts to develop the team for a guy in that state to win a championship at that size. You have to put a team around them for them to succeed. If Allen Iverson had a team around him, he would have been different.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Allen Iverson's competition in the league during his prime
quotes.excerpt: It wasn't his team. It was the guys that he had to go against.
quotes.quote: It wasn't necessarily Allen Iverson. It wasn't his team. It was the guys that he had to go against. Kobe and Shaq were in the league. MJ was in the league. It's tough.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Criticism of Jalen Brunson's shot selection
quotes.excerpt: People were shitting on Jalen Brunson, not us.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson shoots the shit out of the ball. And oh my god, that's what I meant to talk about. People were shitting on Jalen Brunson, not us. But they go at Jalen Brunson for shooting the ball all the time.
